nodes.label: Asynchronous render queue and 64 MiB cache
nodes.rationale: Debouncing, cancellation and viewport-limited delegates keep navigation responsive.

nodes.label: Persistent PDFium render worker
nodes.rationale: Keep parser and scripts outside the desktop process while reusing native form state.

nodes.label: Document and raster bounds
nodes.rationale: 64 MiB inputs, 2000 pages and bounded geometry/raster prevent uncontrolled work.

nodes.label: QtTest offscreen viewer integration
nodes.rationale: Synthetic fixtures check UI behavior and persistence without claiming arbitrary compatibility.

nodes.label: Exact dynamic XFA round trip
nodes.rationale: Two edit/save/close/reopen generations must retain input and calculated values exactly.

nodes.label: Pinned PDF.js independent reader
nodes.rationale: Checks saved field values and layout independently; it does not execute JavaScript.

nodes.label: Packet-array XML whitespace preservation
nodes.rationale: Generated XML formatting previously added a newline to saved values; never trim user data to pass.

nodes.label: Single-stream complete XDP export
nodes.rationale: Serialize current XDP and propagate export failure instead of silently saving stale data.

nodes.label: Pinned PDFium patchset 2 package
nodes.rationale: CMake checks package manifests and rejects unpatched or older dependencies.

nodes.label: Empty calculate nodes remain editable
nodes.rationale: Designer placeholders must not disable radio groups; genuine calculation override checks remain.

nodes.label: Liberation Sans Arial substitution
nodes.rationale: Compatible metrics avoid rich-caption wrapping and clipping on Linux.

nodes.label: Fail-closed Bubblewrap isolation
nodes.rationale: Untrusted scripts must have no host capabilities; publish only exactly verified outputs.

nodes.label: Serialized JSON-line render protocol
nodes.rationale: Persistent worker avoids repeated parsing; asynchronous bounded PNG responses keep UI responsive.

nodes.label: Document-owned typed additions
nodes.rationale: Stable IDs and page-point geometry survive zoom and QML delegate recreation without editing source PDF.

nodes.label: Visual signature image additions
nodes.rationale: Reuse image snapshots while retaining a distinct signature type.

nodes.label: Isolated save worker and atomic destination commit
nodes.rationale: Return bounded bytes and use QSaveFile so document scripts cannot write destination folders; preserve edits after failure.

nodes.label: Refuse additions on full XFA
nodes.rationale: Ordinary page-object APIs cannot safely edit generated full-XFA pages; flattening would lose form behavior.

nodes.label: Revision-aware dirty state
nodes.rationale: Successful save clears only the saved revision so edits made later remain dirty.

nodes.label: Native form event semantics
nodes.rationale: Keep native pages alive and forward events rather than replicating PDFium validation, calculation and focus in QML.

nodes.label: Live native form save snapshot
nodes.rationale: Commit focus and serialize current form state before export to avoid silently discarding field edits or duplicating additions.

nodes.label: Fail-closed Linux seccomp worker policy
nodes.rationale: Namespace callbacks alone cannot constrain compromised native code; block execution, sockets and writable opens.

nodes.label: 768 MiB RLIMIT_DATA worker cap
nodes.rationale: V8 reserves huge virtual ranges, so an address-space cap is unsuitable; test actual allocation and commitment.

nodes.label: Controlled worker failure
nodes.rationale: Keep application additions and report lost native form edits while testing real script hangs.

nodes.label: Advanced capabilities require release gates
nodes.rationale: Defer OCR, form authoring, redaction, PDF/A and plugins until concrete use cases, threat models and interoperability validation exist.

nodes.label: Historical cryptographic-signature deferral
nodes.rationale: Originally required key storage, signing library, incremental saves and trust integration; superseded only for signing by ADR 0008.

nodes.label: Relocatable distribution-specific Linux preview
nodes.rationale: Ship GUI, workers and PDFium together, use distribution Qt and Bubblewrap to avoid another sandbox deployment system.

nodes.label: Preview release validation gates
nodes.rationale: Relocated runtime checks do not replace clean-desktop testing, corresponding source and compatibility gates.

nodes.label: Planned form and signature reliability milestones
nodes.rationale: Extend existing renderer and save paths with licensed real-world coverage rather than introducing a new engine.

nodes.label: Planned staged save and reopen verification
nodes.rationale: Verify supported form values before atomic commit, explicitly report failed or unavailable checks.

nodes.label: Planned cryptographic signatures and trust chains
nodes.rationale: Preserve prior signed revisions and distinguish signature validity from certificate trust.

nodes.label: Bounded compatibility claims
nodes.rationale: Reopening cannot certify script, layout or external-reader behavior; state checks and limits.

nodes.label: Intent-first architecture decisions
nodes.rationale: Record status, context, alternatives and consequences so decisions reflect project direction.

nodes.rationale: Smoke identity checks cannot establish PDF compatibility; exact round trips and isolated runtime tests are required.
